title: Booze Fighters take over Hollister, stealing the headlines

tellings.quote: what happened was a bunch of World War veterans who were in a motorcycle gang called the Booze Fighters, which is a play on Foo Fighters, took over uh Hollister, California for a day and had a drunken party downtown.

plain: Dr. John Brandenburg, a scientist, tells Jesse Michels's podcast that in 1947 a motorcycle gang of World War veterans called the Booze Fighters took over the town of Hollister, California, for a day and threw a drunken party downtown. He says the name was a play on "foo fighters", the term wartime pilots used for strange lights in the sky. In his telling, the story stole the headlines that year, pulling attention away from UFO news.
